origin: cyborg-series-2026-05-15 campaign had REPLACE_WITH_SUBSTACK_URL tokens that required manual audit before publish, and no gate enforced CTA or backlink presence. Built as product feature, not campaign patch.
description: Quality gate for LinkedIn Article publish actions. Blocks unresolved placeholder tokens, warns on missing series backlinks, blocks missing CTAs, and runs LLM quality judge on the opening excerpt.
gates: placeholder_block: any REPLACE_ token or unresolved (coming soon)/(#) link = BLOCK
backlink_check: no linkedin.com/pulse/ or linkedin.com/posts/ in body = WARN
cta_check: no Substack URL or Co-Dialectic GitHub link = BLOCK
quality: LLM judge via PROMPT.md + claude -p on article_excerpt (semantic)
applies_to: Any LinkedIn Article about to be published
LinkedIn Article drafts being handed to a human for manual publish
SDE campaigns that include a linkedin_article spoke

env_flags.SKIP_LLM_JUDGES: Set to '1' to bypass LLM quality judge — for CI environments without claude CLI

litmus: Run HOW.py with article_content — exit 0=safe, exit 1=blocked with remediation, exit 2=warn (proceed with awareness)
